lines.text: For a normal little Tuesday with the daylight glaring
Cup in the sink and the phone keeps ringing
And the doorbell sings like a bad bell swinging
Mail on the mat, and the cat needs feeding
One more form with a name worth reading
Light in the kitchen doing too much meaning
And the whole damn ceiling starts quietly leaning
I’m fine, I’m fine, I’m legally fine
Got a smile on my face like a warning sign
Got a list in my fist and a plan in decline
Got a brain full of scaffolds and fraying twine
Don’t touch that wall, that wall is essential
Don’t ask that thing, that thing is potential
Don’t move that chair, that chair is mental
How much pressure can the old place take?
How many little things before I break?
